# Bundled Python packages

Used by `lib/x-watch.py` only when the system has no python-xlib (it's appended to `sys.path`, so a
system copy wins). Unmodified copies:

| Package | Version | License | Upstream |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Xlib/` (python-xlib) | 0.33 | LGPL-2.1-or-later (`licenses/python-xlib-LGPL-2.1-or-later.txt`) | https://github.com/python-xlib/python-xlib |
| `six.py` | 1.17.0 | MIT (`licenses/six-MIT.txt`) | https://github.com/benjaminp/six |
